$comment: The wrinkle library — GitHub issue #159, GAMEPLAY_AND_NAVIGATION.md § 17. A day's twist is a row here rather than a literal in shift/events.ts, which is CLAUDE.md invariant 7 pointed at content. Every template's effect is expressed ONLY in fields the engine actually reads (arrivalRateMultiplier, directionalSplit, carsOutOfService, derate), because a template that named an effect nothing consumes would be a caption that lies about the picture under it — the defect shift/events.ts was written to prevent. Three of the six wrinkle kinds § 17 names are therefore NOT here and are recorded in `unexpressible` with the seam each one needs. The figures are DRAFTED, not measured: a wrinkle is game feel, and the ladder is the product owner's. See packages/viz/src/wrinkles/. A template that sets a mix also declares `wholeDay`: where its episode sits on a whole authored day (a clock window, a level, a note naming the window, and the reason), or a refusal with its reason. On a whole day shift/episode.ts splices the episode into the day's own phase list and no run-wide multiplier is applied; a refused template is not drawn on a whole day. DECISIONS.md section D1057. The placements are drafted, not measured, on the same footing as the figures.

campaignDay.$comment: How often a CONTRACT day is something rather than nothing — GitHub issue #564. A career day consults its contract's calendar first and the wear clock second; on the days neither claims, this share decides whether the building has a day of its own drawn from the weekday pool. It is authored here rather than in code for CLAUDE.md invariant 7's reason, and its type, range and default are declared by packages/viz/src/wrinkles/parse.ts#CAMPAIGN_DAY_EVENT_SHARE (invariant 8). 20 per cent is derived rather than picked: see campaign/incidents.ts#CAMPAIGN_DAY_EVENT_SHARE_PCT for the arithmetic over a twenty-day contract.

unexpressible.needs: A per-car door-timing override on the run. `EventEffect` reaches cars only through `carsOutOfService` and `derate`, both of which remove a car rather than slow one, so a `doors-slowed` template would render a note no passenger experiences.

A service-zoning override on the run. Closing a transfer floor is a `BuildingConfig` change (service zoning), and `EventEffect` writes demand and car availability only. Collapsing it into a directional split would be a different day wearing the name.

A per-floor population override on the run. Occupancy is building fabric; the nearest reachable lever is the whole-building directional mix, which moves every floor at once and so does not describe one floor spiking.

templates.name: Fire drill
templates.note: The whole building wants the lobby: most trips all shift are on their way down, and more people are moving than on an ordinary day.

wholeDay.note: Twenty minutes where the whole building wants the lobby: {episode} most trips are on their way down, and the building is at or near its busiest. The rest of the day is the tower's own.
wholeDay.reason: Twenty minutes is the design's own length for the drill (design.html's note; section D175 dropped it from the slice because a thirty-minute run could not hold a clock time). 10:00 sits in office-day's morning quiet (09:30-11:45), clear of all three cited peaks, and is where the week swarm's S3 measured it. Intensity 1.0 is the day's own peak level, the highest a phase may carry (core's rule 3): the slice's 1.6 is not carried over, because twenty minutes at 1.6 times the peak put Midtown past its capacity on 10 of 10 crowds in the swarm's S2 measurement. The partial value scales it by the slice's own ratio, 1.3/1.6, to 0.8. An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

templates.name: Conference on the middle floors
templates.note: {size} go floor to floor rather than through the lobby, all shift, which no up-peak strategy is tuned for.

wholeDay.note: {size} go floor to floor rather than through the lobby {episode}, the afternoon between lunch and the evening rush. The morning, lunch and the evening are the tower's own.
wholeDay.reason: The design's own words were 'Interfloor traffic all afternoon'. office-day's afternoon between its cited lunch and evening periods is 13:15-16:15, flat at intensity 0.25 on 45/45/10, so the conference replaces no cited peak's mix. The level is the day's own: the slice moved only the mix and set no rate, and so does this. An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

wholeDay.refused: Coaches are booked only by a career's calendar (campaign/calendar.ts), and a career day runs no whole authored day (section D966), so there is no day to place them in and nobody could check a placement. Refused rather than guessed, so it is not drawn on a whole day.

templates.name: Caterers in early
templates.note: Trolleys and crates through the front door {when}, all of it going up.

wholeDay.note: Trolleys and crates through the front door {when}, {episode}, most of it going up.
wholeDay.reason: The note places the caterers against the morning rush, and office-day's cited up-peak ramp begins at 08:30. 'Before the rush' sits in the opening quiet at 0.25, the day's own between-peaks level, where the opening trickle is 0.05; 'right into the rush' runs 08:20-08:40 on the day's own ramp, which is already the cited peak, and ends before the hold at 08:42:30 so the peak and its mix stay as authored. The slice's 1.35 and 1.55 are not carried over. An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

templates.name: Goods inward all morning
templates.note: Deliveries are being walked floor to floor rather than sent up once.

wholeDay.note: Deliveries are being walked floor to floor rather than sent up once, {episode}.
wholeDay.reason: The name says all morning; office-day's morning after its cited up-peak is 09:30-11:45, flat at 0.25. 0.3 is that level times the slice's own 1.15, rounded (0.2875). An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

templates.name: Unannounced evacuation
templates.note: Nobody was told. The building empties {pace}.

wholeDay.note: Nobody was told. The building empties {pace}, {episode}, and then the day carries on.
wholeDay.reason: Unannounced, so placed away from the fire drill's morning slot and from every cited peak, in office-day's afternoon quiet (13:15-16:15). 'All at once' is fifteen minutes at the peak level; 'floor by floor' is half an hour at half of it, the same number of journeys spread twice as long. The slice's 1.8 and 1.4 are not carried over (core caps a phase at the peak). An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

templates.name: Shift change
templates.note: One crowd leaving as another arrives, and the lobby has to do both at once.

wholeDay.note: One crowd leaving as another arrives {episode}, and the lobby has to do both at once.
wholeDay.reason: Placed mid-afternoon in office-day's quiet stretch. Its mix, 45/45/10, is the day's own between-peaks mix, so on a whole day this wrinkle is a level inside its window and nothing else, which is said here rather than hidden. 'Tight' is twenty minutes at the peak level; 'staggered' is forty minutes at half of it, the same journeys spread twice as long. An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

templates.name: A quiet morning

The mix is placed in office-day's afternoon quiet, 13:15-16:15, which lies inside both windows and replaces no cited peak. The level is the day's own, because the slice set no rate. An uncited assumption, drafted for the owner on section D537's footing, not a citation.

wholeDay.reason: Late morning in office-day's quiet stretch, clear of the cited peaks. Twenty minutes at the peak level, the fire drill's length and level, so the two days differ in the mix and the hour rather than in size. The slice's 1.5 is not carried over.
